camera._comment: hfov/vfov for Pi camera v3 wide ~ 66x41; v2 ~ 62x48. focal_px is a placeholder — calibrate with a known face width at known distance: focal_px = bbox_width_px * distance_m / real_width_m.

mount._comment: Measure on the assembled turret. height = how far above the tilt pivot the camera lens sits; forward = how far ahead of the pivot.
